{{Otheruses|Caf}}
'''Regular caf''' was a way in which [[Caf/Legends|caf]] could be served. [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served freshly ground and brewed regular caf, with [[Bantha cream]] and [[Christophsian sugar/Legends|Christophsian sugar]] available to add in, for 1.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
